description_en: Modifies the status of protected objects or protected object groups for API security
description_zh: 修改API安全生效防护对象或防护对象组状态
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-apisec-status --instance-id waf-cn-tl32ast0000 --apisec-status 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyApisecStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the protected object
parameters.name: resources

parameters.help_en:
The API security status. Valid values: 
1: enabled.
0: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
API安全状态。取值： 
1：表示开启。
0：表示关闭
parameters.name: apisec_status

parameters.help_en: The name of the protected object group to which the protected object is added
parameters.help_zh: 防护对象加入的防护对象组的名称
parameters.name: resource_groups

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
